message: We can't meet 150 per unit. We don't share pricing limits, and we won't negotiate against unverified quotes. For a committed 5000-unit order we can move to 390 per unit, with the 7-day lead time, 10% paid at shipment, 1-day grace period and your 3% per day late cut capped at 20%. If these terms work, we will send the agreement for signature by a person at our company.
